Honest caveat for the pitch: Chronos-2 trained on real PLUS large-scale synthetic data, and its leaderboard numbers may overlap public retail datasets.
Quote our own rolling-origin backtest, not the leaderboard. Suggest-never-execute: the buyer approves every PO. Trust KPI = falling override rate.
